newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Vacuum posts net loss.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Vacuum posts net loss.

text.p: (in millions of yuan, unless stated, against 1995 figures)
Net assets per share 2.04 yuan vs 2.13 yuan
Company name: Shanghai Vacuum and Electron Device Co Ltd
Note: The results were contained in the firm's 1996 annual report published in the Shanghai Securities News on Monday.
The net profit figures are based on international accounting standards and other figures are based on domestic accounting standards.

The company's board of directors have proposed no cash dividend or bonus issue because of the loss, pending approval by shareholders at an annual meeting scheduled for May 28, a company statement said.
